questions.prompt: What does achieving zero findings under `shellcheck -x -S style` mean for your script?

options.b: The mechanical quality floor is met; high-severity logic and trust items from your human checklist were verified by hand

questions.prompt: Why must summary output (`valid=N skipped=M`) be emitted to stderr rather than stdout?

options.a: stdout is the data stream — mixing status messages into stdout corrupts downstream pipeline consumers
options.c: The JQ utility requires stderr logging

questions.prompt: What is the safest architectural fix for a user-supplied jq filter argument?

options.a: Remove the filter parameter from the interface entirely, closing the injection by design
